Name: Add Domains to Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Author: admin
DisplayName: Add Domains to Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules
Description: Action will get as a parameter a list of Domains, and will be able to create or update a rule, filtering the domains from your mailboxes. Actions can be modified in the parameters using rule parameter. WARNING: Action will modify your current users inbox rules, using EWS. NOTICE - to perform operation, please configure EDiscovery Group and Author permissions. For full details, please visit: https://cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/soar/marketplace-integrations/exchang. NOTE: Action is running as async, please adjust script timeout value in Siemplify IDE for action as needed.

Parameters.Description: Specify the Domains you would like to add to the rule, in a comma separated list.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk
Parameters.Description: Specify the rule to add the Domains to. If the rule doesn't exist - action will create it where it's missing.
OptionalValues: Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk

Parameters.Description: If checked, action will be performed in all mailboxes accessible with current impersonalization settings. If delegated access is used, implicitly specify the mailboxes to search in the "Mailboxes" parameter.

Parameters.DisplayName: How many mailboxes to process in a single batch
Parameters.Description: In case "Perform action in all mailboxes" is checked, action works in batches, this parameter controls how many mailboxes action should process in single batch (single connection to mail server).

AIDescription:
### General Description
The **Add Domains to Exchange-Siemplify Inbox Rules** action allows administrators to programmatically manage Microsoft Exchange inbox rules by adding specific domains to a filter list. This is primarily used for automated threat containment, such as moving emails from known malicious domains to the Junk folder or deleting them entirely across multiple mailboxes.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Domains | String | No | A comma-separated list of domains to be added to the rule. |
| Rule to add Domains to | Dropdown | Yes | The specific rule action to perform. Options include: 'Siemplify - Domains List - Move To Junk', 'Siemplify - Domains List - Delete', or 'Siemplify - Domains List - Permanently Delete'. |
| Perform action in all mailboxes | Boolean | No | If enabled, the action attempts to update rules across all mailboxes accessible via the configured integration permissions. |
| How many mailboxes to process in a single batch | Integer | No | Controls the number of mailboxes processed per execution cycle (default is 50) to manage performance and avoid timeouts. |

### Flow Description
1. **Initialization**: The action connects to the Microsoft Exchange server using the provided integration credentials (supporting both Basic and OAuth2 authentication).
2. **Mailbox Discovery**: If 'Perform action in all mailboxes' is selected, the action retrieves a list of all searchable mailboxes; otherwise, it targets the primary mailbox defined in the integration.
3. **Rule Retrieval**: For each mailbox in the current batch, the action checks for the existence of the specified Siemplify rule using Exchange Web Services (EWS).
4. **Domain Merging**: It retrieves existing domains from the rule (if it exists) and merges them with the new domains provided in the parameters to ensure a comprehensive and deduplicated list.
5. **Rule Update/Creation**: The action uses EWS to either update the existing rule with the new domain list or create a new rule if one does not exist for that specific mailbox.
6. **Async Handling**: Because processing many mailboxes can be time-consuming, the action runs asynchronously, processing mailboxes in batches and maintaining state between iterations until all mailboxes are updated.

### Additional Notes
- This action requires the service account to have appropriate EWS permissions, such as Application Impersonation or Delegated Access.
- Either the 'Domains' parameter must be filled, or the action will fail with an 'Incomplete Information' error.
